name: StrikeNova Engineering Rules
description: Project-specific review rules for StrikeNova options trading platform

rules.title: Credential exposure in logs or responses
rules.description: Never log, print, or expose API keys, tokens, passwords, session IDs, or other credentials in responses, logs, or error messages.
rules.check: Verify that no credential material is logged or returned in API responses.

rules.title: SQL injection risk
rules.description: Database queries must use parameterized queries or ORM. Never construct SQL via string concatenation with user input.
rules.check: Verify all database queries use parameterized statements or ORM methods.

rules.title: Missing authentication/authorization check
rules.description: API endpoints that access user data must verify authentication and authorization. Broker operations must verify broker connection ownership.
rules.check: Verify endpoints check authentication and resource ownership.

rules.title: Unsafe session handling
rules.description: Session IDs must be cryptographically strong and stored hashed. The only browser session transport is the HttpOnly strikenova_session cookie.
rules.check: Verify session handling follows ADR-007 and SECURITY.md requirements.

rules.title: Broker token exposure
rules.description: Broker tokens must be encrypted at rest and never exposed to the frontend or logged.
rules.check: Verify broker tokens are encrypted and never returned to clients.

rules.title: Missing input validation
rules.description: All API inputs must be validated. Financial amounts, quantities, and symbols must be validated for type, range, and format.
rules.check: Verify input validation on all API endpoints.

rules.title: CORS misconfiguration
rules.description: CORS must not allow arbitrary origins in production. Verify FRONTEND_URL is used for CORS configuration.
rules.check: Verify CORS is properly configured for production.

rules.title: OAuth state validation missing
rules.description: Broker OAuth state must be HMAC-signed with session binding and TTL. Unsigned state must be rejected.
rules.check: Verify OAuth state validation follows ADR-008.

rules.title: Session fixation risk
rules.description: Session IDs must be regenerated on login. Old sessions must be invalidated on password change.
rules.check: Verify session regeneration on authentication events.

rules.title: Database migration without Alembic
rules.description: Schema changes must go through Alembic migrations. No ad-hoc DDL in application code.
rules.check: Verify schema changes use Alembic migrations per ADR-002.

rules.title: Missing transaction boundary
rules.description: Multi-step database operations must use transactions. Verify rollback on failure.
rules.check: Verify transaction boundaries for multi-step operations.

rules.title: Race condition in concurrent access
rules.description: Shared resources (positions, balances, orders) must handle concurrent access. Verify locking or atomic operations.
rules.check: Verify concurrency control for shared resources.

rules.title: N+1 query pattern
rules.description: Avoid N+1 queries in list endpoints. Use eager loading or batch queries.
rules.check: Verify efficient query patterns.

rules.title: Financial calculation precision
rules.description: Financial calculations must use Decimal, not float. Verify precision for prices, quantities, and P&L.
rules.check: Verify Decimal usage for all financial calculations.

rules.title: Incorrect GEX convention
rules.description: GEX calculations must follow docs/GEX_V1_0_SPEC.md. Verify sign conventions, flip/wall definitions, and aggregation windows.
rules.check: Verify GEX calculations match the specification.

rules.title: Timezone handling error
rules.description: Use IST for market context and UTC for storage. No naive datetime.now() in production paths.
rules.check: Verify timezone handling per ADR-017.

rules.title: Paper trade not server-authoritative
rules.description: Paper trading balances, positions, exits, and P&L must be computed server-side. Client is renderer only.
rules.check: Verify server-authoritative paper trading per ADR-009.

rules.title: WebSocket session authentication missing
rules.description: WebSocket connections must authenticate via cookie. Never accept session credentials from Sec-WebSocket-Protocol.
rules.check: Verify WebSocket authentication uses cookies per ADR-007.

rules.title: WebSocket connection leak
rules.description: WebSocket connections must be properly closed on disconnect. Verify cleanup in finally blocks.
rules.check: Verify WebSocket connection cleanup.

rules.title: Missing error handling
rules.description: API endpoints must handle errors gracefully. No unhandled exceptions leaking stack traces.
rules.check: Verify error handling on all endpoints.

rules.title: Incorrect HTTP status code
rules.description: Use appropriate HTTP status codes: 200 for success, 400 for bad request, 401 for unauthorized, 403 for forbidden, 404 for not found, 500 for server error.
rules.check: Verify correct HTTP status codes.

rules.title: Missing rate limiting
rules.description: API endpoints must have rate limiting. Verify rate limiter is applied.
rules.check: Verify rate limiting on API endpoints.

rules.title: Missing test coverage for new code
rules.description: New features and bug fixes must include tests. Verify test coverage for changed code.
rules.check: Verify tests exist for new functionality.

rules.title: No regression test for bug fix
rules.description: Bug fixes must include a regression test that would have caught the bug.
rules.check: Verify regression tests for bug fixes.

rules.title: Missing security test
rules.description: Security-related changes must include security tests. Verify auth, authorization, and input validation tests.
rules.check: Verify security test coverage.

rules.title: Unbounded query result
rules.description: Database queries must have limits. Verify pagination or LIMIT clauses.
rules.check: Verify query result limits.

rules.title: Missing index for query
rules.description: Frequently queried columns must have indexes. Verify index usage.
rules.check: Verify database indexes for common queries.

rules.title: Hardcoded configuration
rules.description: Configuration must use environment variables. No hardcoded URLs, keys, or paths.
rules.check: Verify configuration uses environment variables.

rules.title: Missing type hints
rules.description: Python functions should have type hints for parameters and return values.
rules.check: Verify type hints on public APIs.
